website_info.meta_description: Medtronic is an international medical device company that develops and manufactures healthcare technologies and therapies. Medtronic focuses on solving global health challenges through innovative technology, with a particular emphasis on expanding access to healthcare for underserved communities.

source_text_excerpt:
Medtronic

Company name: Medtronic

[1] Medtronic
Medtronic plc is an international medical device company. The company's legal and executive headquarters are in Ireland, while its operational headquarters are in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Medtronic rebased to Ireland following its acquisition of Irish-based Covidien in 2015. While it primarily operates in the United States, it operates in more than 150 countries and employs over 90,000 people. It develops and manufactures healthcare technologies and therapies. It is one of the biggest medical tech companies in the world and is currently the largest medical device company in the world by revenue.
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medtronic

[2] Health tech for the digital age | Medtronic
People-centered, data-driven, personalized. Solving our world's biggest health challenges with advanced technology.
Source: https://www.medtronic.com/

[3] Where health meets high tech - Medtronic
From the advanced cardiac and neurovascular care to robotic-assisted surgery, Medtronic transforms the lives of millions worldwide with innovative healt tech.
Source: https://www.medtronic.com/en-us/our-company.html

[4] Expanding Access to Healthcare For All | Medtronic LABS
Medtronic LABS is the only health systems innovator that develops tech-enabled solutions for underserved communities worldwide. Explore our solutions.
Source: https://www.medtroniclabs.org/

[5] Technology | Our Digital Health Platform | Medtronic LABS
Our patented SPICE technology supports healthcare delivery models with communities that pair digital and product technologies across the care continuum.
Source: https://www.medtroniclabs.org/technology-platform/
